description: This file defines the OfbizContentTransform class, which implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel to generate content links within the Ofbiz framework. It processes content URLs, potentially modifying image URLs with size variants, and handles URL encoding and prefixing.

classes.name: OfbizContentTransform
classes.description: A Freemarker transform class that generates content URLs, supporting optional size variants and URL prefixing.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from the provided arguments map, handling TemplateScalarModel and fallback to toString.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that processes and transforms content URLs within the Freemarker environment by handling URL decoding, prefixing, and optional size modification.
